facts.content: Patient reports a 'blinding' headache for 3 days making it difficult to focus or work.
facts.source_text: CC: “blinding” HA x3 days; unable to focus/work

facts.content: Headache onset was sudden upon waking and constant.
facts.source_text: Onset: sudden on waking; constant

facts.content: The headache is global, worse over the right eye.
facts.source_text: Location: global, worse over R eye

facts.content: Headache severity is 8/10, reduced to 5/10 with ibuprofen but never fully resolves.
facts.source_text: Severity: 8/10 → 5/10 with ibuprofen; never fully resolves

facts.content: Associated symptoms include photophobia, visual phenomena, nausea, and presence upon waking.
facts.source_text: Assoc: photophobia; visual phenomena (“shooting lights”); nausea (no emesis); not waking from sleep; present on waking; worse with rapid standing/head movement

facts.content: The headache is not associated with numbness, tingling, weakness, fever, upper respiratory infection symptoms, cough, hemoptysis, smell/taste change, or weight change.
facts.source_text: Neg: no focal neuro Sx (numb/tingle/weakness), no fever, no URI/sinus Sx, no cough/hemoptysis, no smell/taste change, no wt change

facts.content: Patient had prior headaches presenting as mild pressure between the eyes without aura, nausea, or vomiting and responded to ibuprofen.
facts.source_text: Prior HAs: mild pressure between eyes; no aura/N/V; responded to ibuprofen

facts.content: Recent eye exam showed no change in vision.
facts.source_text: Eye exam recently: no change in vision

facts.content: Patient denies significant medical problems.
facts.source_text: PMH: denies significant problems

facts.content: Patient uses ibuprofen as needed.
facts.source_text: ibuprofen PRN

facts.content: Patient has been taking a combined oral contraceptive pill for about 1 year.
facts.source_text: combined OCP (name unk), started ~1 yr ago

facts.content: Patient reports no known drug allergies.
facts.source_text: Allergies: none

facts.content: Mother has migraines with vomiting.
facts.source_text: mother with migraines (with vomiting)

facts.content: Patient lives alone and works from home.
facts.source_text: lives alone; WFH

facts.content: Patient misses work due to headaches.
facts.source_text: missed work due to HA

facts.content: Patient does not smoke and consumes alcohol approximately three units once weekly.
facts.source_text: no smoking; etOH: ~3 once weekly

facts.content: Patient reports no recent travel.
facts.source_text: Travel: none

facts.content: Acute severe headache for 3 days with photophobia and visual phenomena, likely migraine.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute severe headache x3 days with photophobia and visual phenomena; no focal neuro deficits or fever. Likely migraine; needs in-person neuro exam and fundoscopy.

facts.content: On combined oral contraceptive pill, possible contraindication if migraine with aura.
facts.source_text: On combined OCP—if migraine with aura, estrogen-containing OCP may be contraindicated.

facts.content: Needs review of contraception in context of potential migraine with aura.
facts.source_text: 2) Contraception review needed in context of possible migraine with aura.

facts.content: Headache affects work capability.
facts.source_text: 3) Work impact due to HA.

facts.content: Arrange in-person appointment for full neurological exam including fundoscopy and blood pressure check.
facts.source_text: Arrange in-person appt for full neuro exam incl. fundoscopy; check BP

facts.content: Prescribe a stronger NSAID; may take paracetamol concurrently with food.
facts.source_text: Rx stronger NSAID (instead of ibuprofen); may take paracetamol concurrently; take with food

facts.content: If headache worsens, changes, or becomes unbearable, attend A&E or call for advice.
facts.source_text: Safety net: if HA worsens/changes or becomes unbearable → attend A&E; call for advice as needed

facts.content: If symptoms settle before the appointment, patient may cancel the appointment.
facts.source_text: If symptoms settle before appt, may cancel

facts.content: If migraine with aura is confirmed, review or stop combined oral contraceptive pill and discuss alternative contraception.
facts.source_text: If migraine with aura confirmed → review/stop combined OCP; discuss alternative contraception
